pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGER P1 - unusual egress from staging-log-forwarder-2 -> external S3-like endpoint (multiple PUTs, ~92k objects) detected 2024-11-02T01:12Z. Possible debug logs with user identifiers. Auto-alert: authz/exfil.

olivia (on-call): ACK. I'm taking incident lead. Triage window now. @sam can you join sec? @rajeev will you isolate the forwarder pod?

sam (sec): On it. Priorities: 1) isolate, 2) block egress, 3) lock keys & rotate, 4) identify customers impacted. Gathering quick indicators.

rajeev (sre): `kubectl get pods -n staging -l app=log-forwarder` -> forwarder-2 is live on node ip-10-2-45-11. Cordon node and scale down replicaset. Running: `kubectl scale rs log-forwarder-rc --replicas=0` now.

linh (infra): Adding temporary egress deny at edge: creating WAF rule to block outbound to suspicious-host-203[.]0[.]113[.]42 and range. Also updating VPC egress ACL to block that IP. Pushing rule now.

sam (sec): Good. Downloading sample objects from the external endpoint for forensic analysis (read-only). If logs contain PII we'll need Legal/DPO. @hana please start customer impact triage: list top customers writing to staging in last 24h.

hana (cust-succ): On it. Pulling write manifests and upload history. ETA 15m. Will flag any customer with >1k log files.

olivia (on-call): Also: create short incident bridge and socio-bridge. @emily (legal) notified. We'll need timeline and decision on disclosure.

emily (legal): Thanks. If PII present, we need affected customer list + time window. Prep holding statement. Also request retention-minimize: stop any scheduled log-forwarding jobs.

sam (sec): Quick forensic update: sampled objects contain truncated user IDs and request headers. No credit card data observed in quick pass, but PII (email hashes + userids) appear in ~20% of samples. Marking as potential privacy incident.

linh (infra): Starting service-account key rotation for staging-log-forwarder-sa. Creating new key, will update deployment config in staging and rotate secrets in Vault. I'll push rollout to a canary host first.

rajeev (sre): Pod scale-down succeeded. No further PUTs observed after 01:18Z. Confirming: cloud logs show egress spike stopped at 01:19Z.

sam (sec): Good containment signal. But we need to ensure the attacker didn't get a durable copy elsewhere. I'll search for outbound connections from the same node to other hosts.

hana (cust-succ): Preliminary customer list: cust_a, cust_d, cust_e had significant log volumes in window. Sharing secure doc with subset list for Legal/SRE.

olivia (on-call): Action items: 1) SRE/Infra rotate keys + restart forwarder with new credentials (linh/rajeev) 2) SEC to complete forensic export and IOCs (sam) 3) Cust-Succ to draft outreach for affected customers (hana) 4) Legal to advise on notification and regulator risk (emily). Update status every 30m.

linh (infra): Key rotation in progress. Creating new KMS envelope and Vault secret. Will expire old key after verification.

sam (sec): Forensics: snapshotting node, collecting `/var/log/forwarder/*`, and capturing process list. Also pulling container image digest to check for tampering.

emily (legal): If confirm PII, require customer notification within our SLA window - sending initial heads-up to DPO now. Also flagging potential contractual obligations for Dedicated customers.

olivia (on-call): Noted. For public status: hold until we confirm scope. No customer-facing statement yet.

pagerbot: Incident update: status -> contained. No further exfil since 01:19Z. Severity remains P1 until keys rotated and forensics complete. Next update in 30m. :white_check_mark:

sam (sec): Forensics update: evidence suggests misconfigured forwarder rotated to a compromised external endpoint (credential drift). No lateral movement detected so far. Continuing analysis.

rajeev (sre): Forwarder restarted with new credentials on canary node, smoke tests show no egress to external endpoint. Rolling to remaining pods now.

hana (cust-succ): Draft outreach ready for review by Legal + PM. Template includes what we know, timeframe, remediation steps we took, and contact path.

emily (legal): Review done. Minor edits. Approve for sending pending confirmation of final impacted list.

olivia (on-call): Closing loop: if no further anomalies in next 2h, we'll move to post-incident review. Please log any follow-ups to the incident board. Thank you all.

pagerbot: Final: last_message_ts 1728991834 recorded. Archive bridge in 2h unless reopened.
